layers.process: Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park, night trails: hiring a guide is mandatory, with up to six people per guide. Camping and tents are not allowed during the night period. Tickets must be bought in advance, at the box office (open until 4 pm) or the day before.

laws.rule: Goiás state Lei 21.657/2022 bans burning, letting off and handling fireworks and pyrotechnic devices that are high-impact or make a gunshot-like bang, indoors or outdoors, on public or private land. Colour-only, light-effect fireworks without a significant bang are excepted. Lei 22.002/2023 added an exception for cultural festivities officially recognised as heritage where fireworks are essential to the tradition. Offenders have the products seized and are fined an amount the state executive sets.
laws.penalty_signal: seizure and a fine set by the state executive

Lei 11.666/1992
laws.rule: Goiás state Lei 11.666 of 19 February 1992 (as amended by Lei 12.774/1995) bans smoking in closed places where people must pass through or stay, such as auditoriums, conference rooms, museums, theatres, cinemas, libraries, exhibition rooms, crèches, health establishments, school classrooms, buses, taxis and ambulances, and lifts in public, commercial and industrial buildings. Public authorities and private venues must put up visible written notices. The state text sets no fine of its own. Federal Lei 9.294/1996 (as amended by Lei 12.546/2011) also bans smoking in enclosed shared spaces nationwide.
laws.penalty_signal: no state penalty in the text read

public_holidays: 2027-07-26 (Monday): Foundation of the city of Goiás, a state office holiday (Lei 20.756/2020, article 269, II, a). The Governor may move this to a nearby working day, preferably in the same week.
2027-10-24 (Sunday): Laying of the foundation stone of Goiânia, a state office holiday (article 269, II, b).

2027-10-28 (Thursday): Public servants' day, a state office holiday (article 269, II, c). The Governor may move this to a nearby working day. 15 October (Teachers' Day) is optional leave for classroom teachers instead of the 28 October holiday (article 269, paragraph 2).
2027-11-02 (Tuesday): All Souls (culto dos mortos), listed as a state office holiday (article 269, II, d); it is also a national holiday.
culture-cycles.note: These are days with no work in state offices and services, except essential units, under Goiás's civil servants' statute (Lei 20.756/2020, article 269). They are not recorded here as private-sector civil holidays. Carnival Tuesday and Good Friday are also listed in that article as days without state-office work. A 2026 or 2027 decree moving the 26 July or 28 October holidays was not found in the official Casa Civil / Finance 2026 decree index read on 11 November 2026. Municipal holidays are not covered.
